text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Next week's schedule is rather packed.
I had hoped to participate a bit more in volunteer work, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My, Rose-san...
You truly are as dedicated as they say.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No.
As one destined to become a monarch someday...
it is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, we simply do not have enough time,
and I cannot say our efforts have been fully satisfactory.
...It is deeply vexing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is that truly so?
Even though you always listen so earnestly and courteously...
attentively being there for so many people?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not enough.
There must be voices I've failed to hear.
I want to do something to fix that, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When you're the one walking ahead,
it's all too easy to lose sight of what lies behind.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You have your clan, and those who serve you.
While you have your duty as one who shoulders responsibility,
surely there are burdens that can be shared.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is it not also the duty of a sovereign
to answer the devotion of those who wish to support and protect you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Were I your knight...
I am certain I would be restless beyond measure. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—Indeed. It is just as you say.
Somewhere within my heart,
perhaps arrogance had taken root.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Flash-senpai.
I shall take it to heart that relying on and entrusting others is also part of my duty.
